summary: ASTRA HEALTH is an astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform designed to support astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. It monitors health parameters, establishes individual health baselines, compares new readings with normal patterns, and generates alerts when unusual changes are detected. The platform provides a simple dashboard to visualize astronaut health, mission information, trends and alerts. By reducing dependence on continuous internet connectivity, ASTRA HEALTH aims to support health monitoring in remote space environments and help medical teams make informed decisions.
